decision.long: Retain the existing 70/25 one-step profit protection; all tested break-even and stepped alternatives were worse.
decision.short: Do not add moving profit protection; every tested SHORT variant materially worsened the state-aware replay.
decision.exit_evidence: Use the first full closed 1m candle after entry for Spot and Futures TP/SL/profit-lock evaluation.

operational_safety.additional_requests: Two public kline requests per 15-minute system cycle: one Spot 1m and one Futures 1m.
operational_safety.rate_limit_behavior: Bounded retry honors Retry-After for HTTP 429/418 and backs off on temporary server/network failures.
